Swiss Army Bench 0.0.42

- **Pop out any page or table.** Every page has Pop out in its top right corner, every table on its tab and its
  right-click menu, and a Notebooks or Scripts document in its "…" menu. It opens in its own window (the desktop
  app's own window, or a browser tab) in the same state. Its old place goes blank with Reattach and Show window;
  the popped-out window has Reattach too. Closing the popped-out window brings it back by itself.
- **The agent can pop out too.** `app_navigate` takes `pop` (out, reattach, show, list), and `app_screen` says
  what each window has popped out.
